title: Volatility-Adaptive RSI on ETH — Pure RSI Pullback Without 4h Regime Filter
objective: Test pure RSI pullback entries (long when RSI < oversold, short when RSI > overbought) on ETH 1h candles, with volatility-adaptive stop-loss (SL% = ATR × mult / close, which widens in high-vol regimes). The core hypothesis: removing the 4h EMA regime filter used in EMA Trend Gate (which killed 51% of potential windows, producing only 49% positive Sharpe windows) will improve the consistency of positive Sharpe across windows. The strategy is long/short with 1:1 RR and time-based exits. Test on the existing 7.5-year ETHUSDT 1h dataset (64,733 bars) via full WFA with Optuna TPE over 4 optimized parameters (192 combos × 100 trials).
hypothesis: Pure RSI pullback without the 4h regime filter will produce a higher percentage of positive Sharpe windows than EMA Trend Gate (49%), because the 4h filter restricted trades to only trending regimes. With ETH's higher volatility vs BTC, RSI signals should fire more frequently than the 1-9 trades/window that killed vol_adaptive_trend on BTC. If Sharpe OOS >= 0.8 with >= 50% positive Sharpe windows and >= 30 total OOS trades, the pure approach is validated.
strategy_rationale: Why this over alternatives: (1) EMA Trend Gate on ETH (Sharpe 0.528, 85 windows, 1216 trades) used a 4h EMA regime filter that blocked trades in ranging conditions — only 49% of windows had positive Sharpe. The filter improved directional accuracy but hurt consistency. Removing it should raise the positive-window rate. (2) vol_adaptive_trend used Supertrend crossovers on BTC (Sharpe 0.63) but had only 4.3 avg trades/window — too sparse for reliable inference. (3) Pure RSI on BTC is the factory's best result (Sharpe 0.79–0.94) but was never tested on ETH. Why not duplicate: No strategy has tested RSI pullback without any regime filter on ETH. The combination of (a) pure signal + (b) vol-adaptive stops + (c) ETH's higher volatility is genuinely novel for this factory.
dataset_requirements: ETHUSDT 1h candles — maximum available history (~7.5 years, 2018-10 to 2026-03)

historical_depth_requirement.justification: WFA with 3mo train / 1mo test / 1mo step on 7.5 years yields 85+ WFA windows (same as the successful EMA Trend Gate run). ETH's deep history provides statistically meaningful inference. Existing dataset confirmed present — no download required. ETH's higher volatility vs BTC should produce more frequent RSI signals than the 1-9 trades/window that killed prior experiments.

data_acquisition.reason: ETHUSDT 1h deep data already present at workspace/data/binance_ethusdt_1h_deep.csv: 64,733 bars from 2018-10-29 to 2026-03-21. Columns verified: timestamp,open,high,low,close,volume. Same dataset used for the successful EMA Trend Gate WFA run (EXP-20260321200000-01). No download required.

inputs: walk forward engine/src/strategies/vol_adaptive_rsi_eth.py (new strategy — pure RSI pullback + vol-adaptive stops, LightweightVolAdaptiveRSI class with generate_vectorized_signals method; py_compile verified exit 0)

walk forward engine/strategies/vol_adaptive_rsi_eth/wfa_config.yaml (new WFA config — 3mo train/1mo test/1mo step, 100 TPE trials, 4 optimized params, profile_key VOL_ADAPTIVE_RSI; yaml.safe_load verified)
implementation_steps: 1. Pre-execution verification DONE: strategy compiles (py_compile exit 0), YAML valid (yaml.safe_load OK), ETH deep data confirmed (64,734 lines, 2018-10-29 to 2026-03-21, correct columns).
2. Run WFA: cd 'walk forward engine' && .venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/walk_forward_smoke_test.py --config strategies/vol_adaptive_rsi_eth/wfa_config.yaml
3. Parse results from strategies/vol_adaptive_rsi_eth/results/analysis.json: extract aggregate Sharpe OOS, total trades, positive Sharpe windows, max drawdown, win rate.
4. Compare vs benchmarks: EMA Trend Gate ETH (Sharpe 0.528, 49% positive windows), vol_adaptive_trend BTC (Sharpe 0.63, 4.3 trades/window), pure RSI BTC (Sharpe 0.79–0.94).

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: At least 6 complete OOS windows with >= 30 total trades across OOS. Primary risk is insufficient trades — same failure mode that killed London Sweep (2 trades), ATR Breakout (2 trades), and MACD Divergence (WFA never ran). If < 10 trades appear in the first 2 windows, flag as potentially low-signal.

fallback_if_blocked: If WFA execution fails due to environment issue: fall back to pure Python wfa_minimal.py on the same strategy+data (lower quality but produces metrics).
If the pure RSI strategy produces < 10 trades/window: widen RSI thresholds (OS 20-50, OB 50-80) and reduce hold_bars to 24-36 to increase signal frequency.
If total trades across all OOS windows < 30: the RSI signal is too rare on ETH — switch to BTCUSDT 1h deep data with the same strategy.
notes: The 4h EMA regime filter in EMA Trend Gate was the primary suspect for only 49% positive Sharpe windows. Pure RSI without filter tests this hypothesis directly — if positive-window rate stays < 50%, the filter was not the cause.
ETH's higher volatility (vs BTC) should produce more frequent RSI signals than the 4.3 trades/window that limited vol_adaptive_trend's reliability on BTC.

The volatility-adaptive stop mechanism (SL% = ATR × mult / close) provides systematic risk scaling without needing the WFA engine to support dynamic position sizing — it works with the existing vectorized backtester.
Strategy is long/short symmetric with 1:1 risk-reward. Time-based exits (hold_bars) prevent overnight gap risk accumulation.
